purpose: HSPICE S element in the time domain against the lumped network its data came from

oracle.derivation: ngspice -n -b -r s_lumped.raw on the lumped network (rs in p1 50; series 10 ohm + 5 nH p1-p2; 100 ohm p1-0; 25 ohm + 2 pF p2-0; 50 ohm load), same pulse and .tran 1p 3n; samples at ngspice's accepted times. The S element runs the passive rational fit of the Touchstone data; the tolerance (1e-2 V) covers edge timing between the two step sequences.
